newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Jade Technologies offer 189 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Jade Technologies offer 189 times subscribed.

text.p: Jade Technologies Singapore Ltd's public offer of four million shares was about 189 times subscribed, said a company release late on Monday.
The company had offered a total of eight million new shares at Singapore $0.75 each for its Singapore initial public offer, of which half were placed out to investors.

Jade, a subsidiary of U.S. Industries Inc, will be quoted on the Stock Exchange of Singapore second board. It is a producer of leadframes for the semiconductor industry. Net proceeds of S$5.34 million will go for extending its Singapore factory and new equipment. -- Singapore Newsroom 65-8703080
